mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, which precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term coefficient is positive with p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0), strong manufacturing activity supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 250.0, it signals elevated inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 250.0, or Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: During low housing market activity (HOUST < 1000.0), residential construction weakness signals reduced consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1000.0, or Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing growth that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases, or Rank IC is below 0.03.
